title: Disappointing
body: No information about any necessary payment but it takes 15 Seconds to ask you for 5,99 every month without any reason or any benefit to me. There is nothing included in this app that would require server capacity or connection to outside services it could all be based on my devices storage. just straight up not an application worthy of a subscription model
